description: Report behavioural token waste in this project, ranked by cost per session and compared against the previous week. Detectors are a shipped floor plus patterns derived from this project's own history, each carrying what it has actually saved. Use action="apply" to put the fixes we own into force (reversible and measured), or action="revert" with an id to undo one. Changes to your own files are only ever proposed as a diff.

id.description: Rule id, required for revert and optional for apply

name: waste_audit
